## Summary
Adds a draft proposal for the taxonomy term **Identity** at `taxonomy/proposals/identity.md`, for discussion at the Taxonomy Workstream sync.

Proposed definition: "A set of attributes related to an entity," reproducing the ISO/IEC 24760-1:2025 §3.1.2 verbatim wording, with citations across the 2011, 2019, and 2025 editions.

## What's included
- Proposed definition + primary ISO citation
- Scope note on non-uniqueness (an entity may hold multiple identities)
- Required Identity-vs-Identifier disambiguation (AGENTS.md §3)
- Proposed workgroups: Identity & Trust
- A ready-to-use taxonomy entry block for a later, post-KEEP PR

## What this does NOT do
- Does not modify `taxonomy/taxonomy-data.js`. "Identity" has not received a KEEP vote (CONTRIBUTING.md §2) and definitions remain deferred (docs/data-schemas.md), so this is a proposal document, not a backfilled `definition` field.

## Reviewer note
The ISO Online Browsing Platform renders term content client-side and could not be independently verified by automated fetch during drafting. A reviewer with OBP access should confirm the §3.1.2 wording before any merge into the data.
